experiments.scope: Selected target blake3-r1-prefix-v1. 256 organizer-seeded trials; each trial runs the claim's two-level four-sum search on the right digest half (words 0,2,5,7) constrained to its 32 masked bits with sublist size 2048 and 11 filter bits.
experiments.hypothesis: Per-trial success frequency matches the ideal-model prediction 1-exp(-2) = 0.865 for the same algorithm and same fixed function at 32 of the 128 constrained half bits; this supports the four-sum-abundance heuristic used at 128 bits.

experiments.scope: Selected target blake3-r1-prefix-v1. 256 organizer-seeded trials; identical search on the left digest half (words 1,3,4,6) constrained to its 32 masked bits with sublist size 2048 and 11 filter bits.
experiments.hypothesis: Per-trial success frequency matches the ideal-model prediction 1-exp(-2) = 0.865 for the left half, confirming that both independent 128-bit halves exhibit the same four-sum abundance.
